# Number Analytics

> AI-powered statistical software platform enabling businesses to perform advanced data analysis without coding expertise.

Number Analytics provides an intuitive, no-code statistical analysis platform designed for business professionals and data analysts. The platform supports a wide range of statistical methods including ANOVA, regression analysis, conjoint analysis, and clustering, with data import capabilities from spreadsheets and databases. With offices in New York and Seoul, the company serves global customers seeking accessible advanced analytics.

## Key Topics

- Statistical Analysis
- ANOVA
- Logistic Regression
- Conjoint Analysis
- Clustering
- AI-Powered Analytics
- No-Coding Required
- Data Import (Excel, CSV, SPSS)
- Mobile Apps (iOS, Android)
- Automated Insights
- Hierarchical Bayes
- SCAN*PRO
- Customer Analytics
- Advanced Regression Models
- GDPR/CCPA Compliance
